purpose: Audit the Digital Build Factory + Technology Scout addendum against the existing 177 canonical engines before assigning any new engine ID.

overlap_map.gap: Central business-need-to-technical-solution workflow, reproducible stack scoring and preserved decision evidence are not yet complete as one executable flow.

FACT-001 generates engine scaffolds, but the reusable catalog/versioning and generation contract for project/web/app/mobile/ecommerce/plugin/theme/module/integration/automation/content templates and skills is not yet implemented.

WEB-001 is treated here only as a canonical contract target pending its own implementation audit; this repository does not yet evidence a technology-neutral builder/catalog with deterministic template selection and common security/SEO/accessibility/performance gates.

WEB-001 is a canonical contract target whose implementation remains UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_AUDIT in this repository. Any future WordPress/Gutenberg/Elementor/headless stack choice must be evidence-driven and retain migration/rollback contracts; no operational WordPress capability is asserted here.

No dedicated ecommerce builder contract is evidenced, but ecommerce is a digital-build capability that can be represented under WEB-001 plus FACT-001 reusable templates/capabilities without introducing a new logical engine at V0.
App Fénix and App Bootstrap cover web-app foundations, but reusable PWA/mobile/desktop build templates and store-publication preparation gates are not yet evidenced.
The component engines exist canonically, but a reusable skill/capability catalog and builder invocation contract is not yet unified.

Canonical deployment, migration, feature-flag, canary, disaster-recovery, rebuild, business-continuity and company-backup engines cover the logical contract surface, but their implementation states are not upgraded by this audit and a common digital-asset deployment contract for hosting/DNS/CDN/SSL/backups with tested rollback/rebuild remains incomplete.
Marketing and acquisition engines cover campaign/funnel intent, but reusable build assets and unified budget/publication gates remain incomplete.

VOICE-001 is now explicitly included as the most direct canonical overlap for audio/voice, without upgrading its implementation state. The addendum defines broader reusable multimedia pipelines, but the 177-engine master does not require one new engine identity for each media type; image/photo/design/video/avatar/presentation capabilities should initially be modeled as versioned capabilities/tools governed by existing marketing/factory/integration/vendor engines unless future gap evidence proves a new logical engine is necessary.

The canonical engines collectively cover innovation, opportunity, vendor health/replacement, integration inventory, obsolescence and research, but no single continuous workflow yet inventories owned capabilities, detects changes, compares alternatives, records version/evidence/next-review and emits deterministic recommendations.
The multi-company bootstrap sequence exists canonically, but Digital Build orchestration must be inserted as a capability composition rather than a new company fork or server.

audit_conclusion.recommended_architecture: Represent Digital Build Factory and Technology Scout V0 as capabilities/compositions over existing canonical engines, with FACT-001 extended to generate/catalog reusable templates and skills. Do not change the canonical count of 177.
